formats.key: vaultExitBundlesV1InKindRedemptionVaultV1(address vault, (address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv)[] marketParamsList, uint256 exitAssets, (uint256 value, uint256 nonce, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) sharesPermit, uint256 deadline)
effects: Submits the signer's shares permit, so the bundler gets an allowance of sharesPermit.value vault shares from the signer.

Flash-borrows exitAssets of the vault asset from Morpho Blue and supplies it to the listed enabled markets on behalf of the signer, up to the vault's position in each market. The signer receives Morpho Blue supply positions worth exitAssets in total.
Burns vault shares worth exitAssets from the signer through vault.withdraw(exitAssets, bundler, signer). The share price is not checked, and only the share allowance bounds the shares burned.
Sets an unlimited approval from the bundler (not from the signer) to Morpho Blue for the loan token, so the flash loan can be repaid.
formats.shown: "Exit vault into markets" with the vault address, a raw 'Amount (base units)', the deadline, and the loan token, collateral token and LLTV of each market. The shares permit, oracle and IRM are hidden.

findings.title: InKindRedemptionVaultV1 hides sharesPermit, which grants a share allowance and is the only bound on shares burned
findings.evidence: VaultExitBundlesV1.sol vaultExitBundlesV1InKindRedemptionVaultV1: `TokenLib.submitPermit(vault, sharesPermit);` with the code comment `The allowance/permit of shares can also be used to bound the max burned shares.` TokenLib.submitPermit calls `permit(msg.sender, address(this), permit.value, ...)`. Descriptor: {"label": "Shares permit", "path": "#.sharesPermit", "visible": "never"}
findings.fix: Add a field {"path": "#.sharesPermit.value", "label": "Max vault shares spent", "format": "tokenAmount", "params": {"tokenPath": "#.vault"}} and hide it when the permit is empty, or use a label that says it applies only when a permit is signed.

findings.title: InKindRedemptionVaultV1 shows exitAssets as raw base units although the loan token is in calldata
findings.evidence: Descriptor: {"label": "Amount (base units)", "format": "raw", "path": "#.exitAssets"}. Code: `IMorpho(BLUE).flashLoan(loanToken, exitAssets, data)`, where loanToken = vault.asset(), which is the loanToken of every listed market.

findings.title: InKindRedemptionVaultV1 lists markets without saying the signer receives supply positions in them
findings.evidence: Code: `IMorpho(BLUE).supply(marketParams, assets, 0, sender, "")` supplies on behalf of the signer. Descriptor: the market group on `#.marketParamsList.[]` has no label, and the intent is "Exit vault into markets". In case 0, which uses the same layout, the reader thought the LLTV meant 'a borrow or collateral position is involved'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Swap vault shares for Morpho market deposits" and label the group "You receive supply positions in".

findings.title: InKindRedemptionVaultV1: storage allocation decides which markets get positions and how much each gets
findings.evidence: onMorphoFlashLoan: `if (!IMetaMorpho(vault).config(marketParams.id()).enabled) continue; uint256 vaultAssets = MorphoBalancesLib.expectedSupplyAssets(...); uint256 assets = UtilsLib.min(vaultAssets, assetsToDeallocate);`

findings.title: InKindRedemptionVaultV1 hides the market oracle and IRM, which are part of the market identity
findings.evidence: Descriptor: oracle and irm fields have "visible": "never". Code: `marketParams.id()` hashes all five values. Only markets enabled in the vault get a position, which limits the impact.

formats.key: vaultExitBundlesV1InKindRedemptionVaultV2(address vault, address adapter, (address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv)[] marketParamsList, uint256 exitAssets, (uint256 value, uint256 nonce, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) sharesPermit, uint256 deadline)
effects: Submits the signer's shares permit, so the bundler gets an allowance of sharesPermit.value vault shares from the signer.
Withdraws up to exitAssets of the vault's idle asset by burning the signer's shares, and sends those assets to the signer's wallet.
For the rest, supplies (exitAssets - idle)/(1+penalty) of the asset to the listed markets on behalf of the signer. The signer receives Morpho Blue supply positions.
For each supply, calls forceDeallocate and withdraw on the vault. These burn the signer's vault shares for the deallocated amount plus the force-deallocate penalty.
The share price is not checked. Only the share allowance bounds the shares burned.
formats.shown: "Exit vault into markets, may pay a penalty" with the vault, a raw 'Exit value before penalty (base units)', the deadline, and the loan token, collateral token and LLTV of each market. The shares permit, adapter, oracle and IRM are hidden.

findings.title: InKindRedemptionVaultV2 hides sharesPermit: the vault-share allowance it grants is not shown
findings.evidence: Case 0 mined: approval of 11761074799546078162954 NOONECOUSDC from the signer to the bundler (signer: grant). TokenLib.submitPermit: `permit(msg.sender, address(this), permit.value, ...)`. Descriptor: "#.sharesPermit" has "visible": "never". The code comment says the permit bounds the max burned shares.

findings.title: InKindRedemptionVaultV2: idle vault assets go to the signer's wallet, but the intent says only 'into markets'
findings.evidence: Code: `IVaultV2(vault).withdraw(assetsToWithdrawFromIdle, address(this), msg.sender); SafeTransferLib.safeTransfer(asset, msg.sender, assetsToWithdrawFromIdle);` Intent: "Exit vault into markets, may pay a penalty".
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Exit vault to wallet and market deposits" or add a note that idle assets are paid out first.

findings.title: InKindRedemptionVaultV2 shows exitAssets raw although the loan token is in calldata
findings.evidence: Descriptor: {"label": "Exit value before penalty (base units)", "format": "raw"}. In case 0 the screen shows '11768796706', and the reader could not tell the token or decimals.

findings.title: InKindRedemptionVaultV2 does not say the signer receives supply positions in the listed markets
findings.evidence: Code: `IMorpho(BLUE).supply(marketParamsList[i], assets, 0, msg.sender, data)`. The market group has no label. In case 0 the reader read the LLTV as a sign of 'a borrow or collateral position'.
findings.fix: Label the group "You receive supply positions in".

findings.title: InKindRedemptionVaultV2: the penalty rate and the per-market split come from vault storage
findings.evidence: `uint256 penalty = IVaultV2(vault).forceDeallocatePenalty(adapter);` In case 0 the vault burned 35.18 shares (35200788 USDC) as penalty.

cases.notes: Signer effects: grant of NOONECOUSDC shares to the bundler (hidden permit), and about 11761 NOONECOUSDC shares burned. The signer also receives a Morpho Blue supply position worth 11733.6 USDC, which is not a token transfer. The screen shows the exit value raw and does not name the shares. The reader missed the grant and only guessed that shares leave.

formats.key: vaultExitBundlesV1ForceWithdrawVaultV2(address vault, address adapter, uint256 exitAssets, uint256 minSharePriceE27, (uint256 value, uint256 nonce, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) sharesPermit, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)
effects: Submits the signer's shares permit, so the bundler gets an allowance of sharesPermit.value vault shares from the signer.
Burns the signer's vault shares to withdraw the idle and liquidity-adapter assets without penalty, then force-deallocates the rest with a penalty paid in the signer's shares.
Checks that withdrawn*1e27/sharesBurnt >= minSharePriceE27, which bounds the shares burned.
Sends referralFeePct of the withdrawn assets to referralFeeRecipient.
Sends the withdrawn assets minus the referral fee to the signer. This is at most exitAssets, less the penalty.
formats.shown: "Force withdraw, may pay a penalty" with the vault, a raw 'Amount (base units)' and the deadline. Referral fee % and fee recipient show when they are not zero. The minimum share price, shares permit and adapter are hidden.

findings.title: ForceWithdrawVaultV2 hides minSharePriceE27, the only slippage bound on vault shares burned
findings.evidence: Code: `require(totalSharesBurnt == 0 || withdrawn.mulDivDown(1e27, totalSharesBurnt) >= minSharePriceE27, SlippageExceeded());` Descriptor: {"label": "Min share price", "path": "#.minSharePriceE27", "visible": "never"}. In cases 1 and 2 the signer burned 292629 hyperUSDCa and 98483 satUSDC shares, and the screen gives no share amount or bound.
findings.fix: Show minSharePriceE27 with a format and a label such as "Min assets per share (1e27 scale)", or use unit with decimals 27.

findings.title: ForceWithdrawVaultV2 hides sharesPermit, which grants the bundler an allowance on the signer's vault shares
findings.evidence: Case 1 mined: approval of 292808229086517865502840 hyperUSDCa from the signer to the bundler (signer: grant). TokenLib.submitPermit: `permit(msg.sender, address(this), permit.value, ...)`. Descriptor: "#.sharesPermit" has "visible": "never".

findings.title: ForceWithdrawVaultV2 labels exitAssets 'Amount', but the signer receives it less the penalty and referral fee
findings.evidence: Code: `assetsToDeallocate = (exitAssets - assetsToWithdraw).mulDivDown(WAD, WAD + penalty)` and `safeTransfer(asset, msg.sender, withdrawn - referralFeeAssets)`. Case 1: the screen shows 310500000000 and the signer received 310496895031 USDC. The sibling in-kind V2 format uses 'Exit value before penalty'.
findings.fix: Change the label to "Max received before penalty and fee (base units)".

findings.title: ForceWithdrawVaultV2 cannot name the asset received, because it is vault.asset() from storage
findings.evidence: Code: `address asset = IVaultV2(vault).asset();`. No calldata parameter holds the asset, so exitAssets stays raw. In cases 1 and 2 the readers did not know the token was USDC.

cases.notes: Effects: hidden permit grant of hyperUSDCa to the bundler; 292629 hyperUSDCa shares burned (not shown); 310496.895031 USDC received, shown only as a raw 310500000000 with no token or recipient.
No permit was used. Effects: 98483.8 satUSDC shares burned (not shown, and the min share price is hidden); 99999.000009 USDC received, shown raw as 100000000000 with no token.

couldNotCheck: The Vault V2 forceDeallocate/withdraw and MetaMorpho withdraw source is not in the directory. How the force-deallocate penalty is taken from the signer's shares was read only from mined receipts (cases 0, 1, 2), not from code.
